title: Extra tools
description: Plugins enabled from the gallery or installed from a file. They are applied after all the other tools, in the order they were enabled, and each one runs separately from the rest of the program.

gallery.label: Gallery…
gallery.hint: Opens the gallery to enable more plugins

noPlugins: No plugins enabled. The Gallery button and the Plugins menu open the gallery, where you can enable them.

missing.text: The project uses the plugin “{id}”, which is neither enabled nor installed, so it is not applied.

tool.orderHint: Position in the plugin execution order
tool.applyHint: Computes the image with all the adjustments of the Process step, including “{name}”
